name: path-privacy
description: Enforces one rule: every path written into a repo must be relative to the repo root. Ships a SessionStart directive plus pre-commit and commit-msg git hooks that hard-block. The git hooks are frozen at install time by necessity, so the SessionStart hook refreshes them in place when the wrapper template changes -- no shell script to re-run. Stamped with a template version, not the plugin version, so unrelated releases raise no false staleness.
